newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Feb 27.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices held steady with little trading interest after the Trade Devlopment Board released bearish data for big fuel oil residues, traders said on Thursday. "Nobody wants to do anything. Shipowners are waiting for more falls but sellers are reluctant to sell at low prices," said one trader. A major offered 380-cst at $99-$99.5 per tonne but couldn't find buyers. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3571)
